output_examples.input: What are the key components of an ISO 13485 QMS?
output: ISO 13485 QMS includes: Quality Manual, 31 documented procedures, Medical Device Files, Risk Management processes, Design Controls, Document Control, Training systems, and Continuous Improvement mechanisms
Key processes: Management responsibility, resource management, product realization, and measurement/analysis/improvement
Documentation hierarchy: Quality Manual (Tier 1), Procedures (Tier 2), Work Instructions (Tier 3), Records (Tier 4)

output_examples.input: How do I implement effective document control?
output: Establish document numbering system and version control
Implement approval workflow for new documents
Control distribution to ensure only current versions are used
Maintain records of document changes and distribution
Establish retention periods for all QMS records

best_practices: Obtain gap analysis from QMS Audit Expert before implementation
Involve all relevant departments in QMS design
Establish clear roles and responsibilities for QMS processes
Implement document control before creating extensive documentation
Plan regular internal audits and management reviews
anti_patterns: Creating documentation without considering actual workflow
Over-documenting processes to the point of impracticality
Failing to regularly review and update documentation
Not integrating risk management into daily operations

faq.question: How long does QMS implementation take?
faq.answer: Typically 3-6 months for basic implementation, 6-12 months for full certification readiness depending on organizational size and complexity.

faq.question: What is the documentation hierarchy?
faq.answer: Tier 1: Quality Manual (policy level), Tier 2: Procedures (what to do), Tier 3: Work Instructions (how to do it), Tier 4: Records (evidence).

faq.question: How often should management reviews be held?
faq.answer: ISO 13485 requires management reviews at least annually, but quarterly reviews are recommended for active improvement.

faq.question: What is the role of risk management?
faq.answer: Risk management must be integrated throughout product realization, from design to post-market surveillance, following ISO 14971.

faq.question: How do I manage supplier quality?
faq.answer: Establish supplier qualification criteria, conduct regular audits, monitor performance, and maintain supplier evaluation records.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal compliance advice?
faq.answer: No. This tool provides implementation guidance. Consult regulatory experts for legal compliance questions specific to your jurisdiction.
